nw-account-sync|demo-account-api.rationale: The fictional integration calls the exact endpoint that the synthetic release removes. Update the integration before upgrading.

test_case.title: Verify account sync after endpoint migration
steps: Point a test copy of the integration at /v2/accounts.
Run a sync with a known test account.
Compare the resulting billing record with the source account.
test_case.expected: The integration completes and the billing record matches the test account.

nw-backlog-report|demo-backlog-report.rationale: The fictional report uses the affected subject area. The release preserves columns, so verify aggregation behavior without assuming breakage.
nw-backlog-report|demo-backlog-report.cited_text: verify totals when using queue grouping

test_case.title: Compare service backlog totals
steps: Record totals for a fixed set of service requests.
Run the report after the update with and without queue grouping.
Reconcile both totals against the fixed input set.
test_case.expected: Grouped and ungrouped totals match the known service request count.

nw-summary-field|demo-service-summary.rationale: The optional fictional feature may replace manual summary drafting. An agent should compare its output with the current process before adoption.
nw-summary-field|demo-service-summary.cited_text: administrators can opt in to automatic service request summaries

test_case.title: Evaluate automatic summaries against manual summaries
steps: Enable the optional feature in a test environment.
Generate a summary for a sample request with known notes.
Have an agent compare it with the manually maintained summary.
test_case.expected: The agent can review a draft containing the important facts from the sample request notes.

nw-quote-validation|demo-account-api.rationale: The signed-quote validation does not use the account endpoint. The supplied release text does not establish an impact on opportunity validation.
